# Account Requirements (draft v3, compiled from three stakeholder emails)

1. Passwords must be strong.
2. Passwords must have at least 8 characters.
3. For compliance, passwords must have at least 12 characters.
4. Login should be fast.
5. Admins can delete user accounts.
6. Accounts can never be deleted; they can only be deactivated.
7. Users are locked out after several failed login attempts.
8. Usernames are unique.
